title: About Me
subtitle: Frontend developer with 9+ years of experience building modern, scalable web applications
paragraph: A frontend developer who turns complex challenges into simple, user-friendly solutions. My journey in software development began 9 years ago, and I've been crafting seamless digital experiences ever since.

I specialize in Angular and React, combining modern frameworks with best practices to deliver high-performance, accessible, and maintainable applications. Every project is a balance of clean code and intuitive design.
